reasoning.step1:
Classification: document is an invoice (contains "Rechnung", invoice number, totals, VAT lines).

Key evidence and candidate fields:
- Invoice date candidates:
  - "Stans, 2024-01-24" (near header) — treat as Invoice.Date.
  - "vom: 2024-01-23" refers to "Ihr Auftrag" date — not invoice issue date.
  Chosen Invoice.Date: "2024-01-24".

- Grand total:
  - "Endbetrag EUR 19.238,12" → numerical value 19,238.12
  Chosen GrandTotal.Amount: 19238.12

- Net amount:
  - "MWSt-Basis 1 17.489,20" and line "Auftragssumme 17.489,20" → net (tax base) 17,489.20
  Chosen Net.Amount: 17489.20

- VAT rate and VAT amount:
  - "MWSt 10,00" and corresponding "1.748,92" → VAT rate 10%, VAT amount 1,748.92
  Chosen Vat.Rate: 10
  Chosen Vat.Amount: 1748.92

- Sender VAT ID:
  - "Darbo-UID-Nr.: ATU31800708" → Sender.VatId: "ATU31800708"

Verification notes / no-inference policy:
- All numeric values taken exactly from text with comma-to-decimal conversion preserved to two decimals.
- No other VAT groups found; single VAT group used.
- If asked to output JSON next, will populate fields exactly as identified.
reasoning.step2:

- GrandTotal.Amount = 19238.12
  - Evidence: "Endbetrag EUR 19.238,12" explicitly states the invoice total. Comma used as decimal separator converted to period.
  - Internal consistency: Net (17.489,20) + VAT (1.748,92) = 19.238,12 matches.
  - Confidence: Very high.

- Net.Amount = 17489.20
  - Evidence: "Auftragssumme 17.489,20" and "MWSt-Basis 1 17.489,20" indicate tax base / net amount.
  - Internal consistency: Adds with VAT to GrandTotal.
  - Confidence: Very high.

- Vat.Rate = 10
  - Evidence: "MWSt 10,00" shown alongside VAT amount; standard presentation for percentage. Rule requires no "%" symbol; extracted as 10.
  - Confidence: High.

- Vat.Amount = 1748.92
  - Evidence: "1.748,92" shown next to MWSt and Endbetrag; matches Net * 10% = 1.748,92.
  - Confidence: Very high.

- Sender.VatId = "ATU31800708"
  - Evidence: "Darbo-UID-Nr.: ATU31800708" clearly labeled as sender UID/VAT number.
  - Confidence: Very high.
